posts.coverText: 5 ridiculously silly questions to ask your partner tonight

slideText.text: If you could ban me from doing one thing forever, what would it be?
What's one thing about you that you think only I could put up with?
If our relationship were a movie, what genre would it be and who would the audience blame for the drama?
If we were on a reality show, what would viewers roast me for every single episode?
What's something I do that would be a red flag if you weren't already in love with me?

posts.coverText: 5 funny questions to ask in your relationship

slideText.text: If you had to give me a new name what would it be?
If you could ban me from doing one thing what would it be?
What's something I think I'm good at but am actually terrible at?
If I came with a warning label what would it say?
What's my superpower and what's my kryptonite?

posts.coverText: 4 things for late night talks

slideText.text: Do you think we met at the right time in life?
If you had to describe our connection in one word, what would it be?
What's one thing you'd change about how we handle conflict?
How do I make you feel special in ways no one else does?

posts.coverText: Hypothetical things to ask your man

slideText.text: You're blindfolded in a room with 20 other girls, and no one can speak. How would you know which one was me?
Be honest: if you could mute me for one hour every day, what time would you choose?
If I woke up tomorrow with no memory of us, would you try to make me fall in love with you again or would you let me go?
What version of me did you fall in love with that you don't see anymore?
What was it about me that made you stop looking?

posts.coverText: 5 extra sweet questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What do you call me in your head when you miss me?
What's something about me that stands out to you?
If we switched lives for a day, what's one thing you'd totally mess up as me?
What's one thing I do that makes you feel loved?
What's a habit of mine you've grown weirdly attached to?

posts.coverText: Ragebait your man with these impossible questions

slideText.text: Do you love me because I'm pretty or think I'm pretty because you love me?
If I had an identical twin would you have picked her?
Would you rather have never met me or lose me tomorrow?
If we broke up who's winning the breakup?
Rate me out of 10. there is a correct answer?

posts.coverText: Can your boyfriend answer these 5 questions?

slideText.text: What's the most "that's my girl" thing I've ever done?
When did you last look at me and think “damn, she’s mine”?
What do I do that gives you butterflies even now?
What's your favorite thing about me that isn't physical?
What moment made you realize I was different from everyone else?

posts.coverText: Extra sweet questions to ask your girlfriend

slideText.text: What was your first clue that I liked you?
If you had to brag about me to someone, what would you say first?
What’s something I do that secretly makes you feel loved?
When did you realize I was different from everyone else?
If you could freeze one moment of us forever, which one would it be?

posts.coverText: Only your boyfriend knows the answers to these questions

slideText.text: How do I act when I'm super happy?
What's your favorite weird habit of mine?
Why do you think I fell in love with you?

posts.coverText: 5 extra sweet questions to ask your girlfriend

slideText.text: Which part of me is underrated?
What tiny thing I do shows I care?
When do you feel the safest with me?
What's a moment with me you replay in your head when you miss me?
Do I still give you butterflies? When?

posts.coverText: 5 brutal ragebait questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: If a bird pooped on me, would you wipe it with your favorite t shirt?
If a 7 year old bullied me at a birthday party would you protect me?
If I said I didn't want fries then ate half of yours would you say anything?
If I wore my shirt inside out to your family dinner, would you let me be?
If I fell asleep on a stranger's shoulder on the train what would you do?

posts.coverText: Lowkey nosy questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What did you get completely wrong about me when we first met?
Be honest: how much did you stalk me online before we ever talked?
What was the first thing you told your friends about me?
Did you ever screenshot something I posted and send it to your friends?
What was the biggest red flag you thought I had before you actually got to know me?

posts.coverText: Questions for bedtime talks

slideText.text: What assumption did you make about me that turned out to be false?
What's the most attractive thing I do without realizing it?
What was the first thing you noticed about me?

posts.coverText: questions any boyfriend should be able to answer

slideText.text: After our first date, did you think we’d go out again?
What was the first thing you told your family about me?
What went through your mind during our first kiss?
When was the last time I gave you butterflies?

posts.coverText: 5 questions for late night conversations

When did you start hoping I'd make a move?
What do I do that gets you every time?
What was the moment you fell in love with me?

slideText.text: If your mom told you to break up with me tomorrow, would you listen to her or fight for us?
If a girl who was 100% your “physical type” hit on you, would you stay loyal?
Be honest: what is the most exhausting part of being in a relationship with me?
Are you with me because you truly love me, or just because you’re scared of starting over?
Who is the one person from your past that took you the longest to get over?
